prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. Over the course of eleven visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program with periodic reassessment. The mechanism of injury and the reported symptoms are closely aligned, and the clinical picture fits the force involved in this type of impact. Range of motion was reduced in several planes and palpation of the cervical paraspinal muscles produced tenderness, while neurological screening and certain orthopedic provocation tests were within normal limits. The course of treatment extended somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this severity, reflecting a gradual rather than rapid response. No prior injury or treatment involving the same region is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect each service once as delivered, with no duplicate or repeated charges. Ongoing plan includes continued home exercise and follow-up if symptoms recur.
